title: One teaspoon of neutron star material weighs billions of tons.
purpose: Illustrate density with a relatable comparison.
narration: Imagine a single teaspoon. Now imagine it filled with material from a neutron star. That tiny spoonful would weigh billions of tons, heavier than all of humanity combined. That's the incredible density of a neutron star.

claims.text: A teaspoon of neutron star material weighs billions of tons.
That tiny spoonful would be heavier than all of humanity combined.
